sentences.text: Half Girlfriend is an Indian romantic drama film based on the novel of the same name written by Chetan Bhagat .	Chetan Bhagat	Chetan Bhagat	Half Girlfriend	Half Girlfriend	romantic drama	Romance film	novel of the same name	Half Girlfriend
The film is directed by Mohit Suri and features Arjun Kapoor and Shraddha Kapoor in the lead roles .	Mohit Suri	Mohit Suri	Arjun Kapoor	Arjun Kapoor	Shraddha Kapoor	Shraddha Kapoor

Principal photography commenced in June 2016 and filming locations include Delhi , Mumbai , Patna , Dumraon , Varanasi , New York City and Cape Town .
